name: bioRxiv / medRxiv research article
capBasis: Project editorial budgets (not publisher-wide limits). PLOS abstract cap of 300 is publisher policy. Short format total includes all main text except references and title page. Separate main-display budget counts titles, captions and table cells; individual caption limits apply to main and supplementary displays. These are project editorial budgets.

policies.quote: simple automated/computational analyses of public data
policies.rule: Reject formulaic single-pair, single-dataset, unvalidated work; public data only; one server.
Fresh owner/host policy receipt required: AI drafting and conclusions must be permitted with disclosure; AI never an author.

feeNote: Local packaging has no fee. Preprint posting is generally free; a later journal may charge. Research-note target and its policies must be confirmed before submission.
